pages.text:
Right-click Loam Farmland, or the crop on it, to add nutrients (up to 15):
- Compost: +2, from a Compost Bin.
- Wood Ash: +3. Burning charcoal in a Firebox or Combustion Plant leaves Wood Ash in its ash slot half the time.
- Basic Slag: +3. An Arc Crusher crushes one Slag into two.
- Mixed Fertilizer: +8, crafted from one of each.
- Seed Meal: +1, from a Millstone or Mill.
- Digestate: +4, from the Biogas Digester.
- NPK Fertilizer: +15, from the Chemical Reactor. It also enriches the soil: see NPK Fertilizer.
